title: NIST WebBook: Nitric oxide gas-phase standard enthalpy of formation
summary: The WebBook lists 1 gas-phase standard enthalpy of formation row(s) for Nitric oxide. Reviewed rows and experimental rows are both quoted.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook gas-phase standard enthalpy of formation rows for Nitric oxide (CAS 10102-43-9) print: 90.29 kJ/mol, method Review, reference Chase, 1998, comment: Data last reviewed in June, 1963 (calculated or reviewed row). The page mixes reviewed or averaged rows with rows tied to a named experiment or compilation. A Review or AVG method is an evaluation. A Ccb method is combustion calorimetry, as the WebBook method code is linked. This card does not average the rows into a new number.
